In addition to the ongoing 25% discount on AirPods Pro 3, and last week's $120 off AirPods Max 2, today's 9to5Toys lunch special highlights Amazon dropping the AirTag 2 price to a new all-time low, with the four-pack at just $80 (or $20 each). We also have the Apple M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB at $320 off, as well as this 2TB M5 Pro at $500 off. Don't miss Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card hitting an all-time low of $25 on Amazon, and the LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor that's $2,200 cheaper than the Apple Studio Display XDR (all-time low). See below for details.

AirPods Pro 3 continues to be discounted by 25%, next generation not expected until 2027

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

Good news! AirTag 2 drops again, four-pack at just $80, a new all-time low (or $20 each)

Nice! Amazon is now offering the lowest price ever on the Apple 2026 AirTag 2 four-pack, just $20 each.

Amazon is currently selling the AirTag 2 four-pack for $79.99 with free shipping.

Last week we were tracking this official four-pack at $89.99, then Amazon dropped it to $85 yesterday, and the new week kicks off with an even lower price. Original price $99, now nearly 20% off. While that might not sound like much, it's a notable discount for the latest AirTag 2.

This works out to just $20 per AirTag, the lowest price since its earlier release this year.

The single AirTag 2 remains at the $24 Prime member free shipping low we found last week, but the four-pack has dropped even further.

That said, this $20-per-tag price matches the best deal we found at Best Buy last week.

Apple M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB drops $320 today, 2TB M5 Pro drops $500

Beyond the ongoing 25% discount on AirPods Pro 3 and the AirTag 2 hitting its lowest price we've tracked, this week we also have several notable deals on the latest MacBook Pro lineup. Amazon still has the 2TB M5 Pro at $500 off, and we've also found the more affordable M5 MacBook Pro 24GB model at $320 off. Details below.

If you're eyeing the more powerful M5 Pro, Amazon's $500-off model is definitely worth a look. But if the more affordable M5 is your target, B&H has an attractive option with this 14-inch 24GB/1TB configuration:

B&H is once again selling the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,899 with free shipping.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (original price $2,219)
  • Includes the upgraded 96W Apple power adapter

This machine is originally priced at $2,199, and B&H also throws in the original 96W Apple power adapter — which costs an extra $20 if configured on Apple's website.

Amazon currently sells the same MacBook Pro configuration for $2,049, with the standard 70W charger.

Overall, this B&H deal saves you $320, matching the deals we've mentioned before, and is a better value than Amazon's current price.

As mentioned above, Amazon still has a notable discount on the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB, at $2,699 — that's $500 off the original $3,199, and this deal likely won't last long.

Anker's new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card supports iOS or Android, drops to all-time low of $25 on Amazon

Anker recently launched its new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card — their first product compatible with both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — now down to an all-time low of $25 on Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members.

It just went on sale at Amazon for $35 last month, had a slight $5 discount at month's end, and now sees its first significant price drop, hitting an all-time low on Amazon.

This discount is close to 30%, matching the best deals we've tracked on similar wallet tracker cards this year.

Personally, I'm quite fond of Nomad's tracker cards — starting from $35, with the Pro model featuring 16-month battery life that requires recharging at $45 — but no matter which you pick, I think everyone should put one in their wallet or card holder. I never leave the house without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 comes with all the most important features, including wireless charging, and is compatible with both the Apple Find My platform and Google Find Hub. It's just 1.7mm thin, with a ring volume of up to 80 decibels to help you find it nearby — and of course, you can also see its location on a map through the Find My and Find Hub apps.

Organize your desk with Anker's clever clamp-on power strip, now just $58

LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor hits lowest price, $2,200 cheaper than Studio Display XDR

We found a deal at B&H dropping the LG 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K monitor to $1,099.99 with free shipping. This monitor originally launched at $2,000 and has sold for as much as $1,597 in recent months. Today's deal essentially matches the all-time low that first appeared on Amazon earlier this month (and is still valid). LG is also price-matching at $1,100 today, giving you another option in case one retailer runs out of stock. At this price, the UltraFine evo 6K is significantly cheaper than Apple's displays. The Studio Display XDR starts at $3,299, meaning the LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor is about $2,200 cheaper. Even the standard Studio Display starts at $1,549, so you save about $500 while getting a larger 32-inch 6K screen. See below for details.

The LG 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K is a high-end workstation monitor designed for creators who want a large, high-resolution screen without upgrading to Apple's pricier options. Its 6144 x 3456 display has over 21 million pixels at 224 PPI, giving you plenty of space to edit timelines, full-resolution content, tools, and multiple windows. It covers 99.5% Adobe RGB and supports VESA DisplayHDR 600 for better highlights and contrast. Connectivity is also plentiful, including Thunderbolt 5, DisplayPort 2.1, HDMI, and USB-C. Mac users can also use LG Studio Mode's color calibration presets for more consistent creative work. Overall, this is a fully-featured 6K option for those who want professional-grade screen real estate without paying Apple display prices.

If you don't want to spend over $1,000 on a new monitor, Woot also has several more affordable Samsung workstation monitor deals. A range of M-series and other budget-friendly models are now discounted, starting from $118.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • This ultra-thin UGREEN wallet tracker is compatible with both iPhone and Android, now just $20 (all-time low)
  • This compact UGREEN ultra-thin 45W Nexode Air charger is the thinnest one in my EDC, now just $27
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro wireless audio transmitter drops to $40 on Amazon (black or white)
  • Chipolo Google Find Hub wallet card with super button/remote camera shutter, now just $33
  • UGREEN MagFlow 25W Qi2.2 car charger returns to $28 (original price $40)
  • Acer metal MagSafe golf cart phone holder plummets to $20, free shipping for Prime members

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low on Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also discounted)

As part of the late summer deals on Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Blink smart home products, Amazon is also offering the lowest price ever on the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro, and bringing the wired model back to its Prime Day all-time low — both nearly 30% off their original prices.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)

Although the brand has since launched the more affordable Ring Peephole Cam 2K at $100, today we're highlighting several notable deals on the latest Pro series 4K models.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro is now back to its Prime Day all-time low price, for the first time since its late June promotion. In fact, this is only the second time we've tracked this model below $200.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro sees its first discount, also hitting an all-time low of $180.

As mentioned above, both models are originally priced at $250, now nearly 30% off — the best deals we've found, and the lowest prices ever.

The two are largely the same, featuring up to 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K imaging for clearer monitoring of your doorstep. The wireless version comes with a Quick Release Ultra battery pack for easy charging and simpler installation (no wiring needed), while the wired version offers 'endless power, endless protection.'

For more details, check out our September unboxing coverage from last year.

Best Buy launches new tech deals, NFL Sunday Ticket promotion, and preseason TV deals

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 in stock, $120 off (one of the best prices ever for some)

This week's major 60th anniversary deals bring one of the best prices ever on the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering $120 off all five colors.

Amazon is currently selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Priced the same as the previous generation at $549, you can now save $120 — the best price currently from a reputable retailer for a new unit.

Best Buy has the Midnight black version for $403.99 with free shipping in 'excellent' open-box condition. While cheaper, it may not be low enough to give up on a brand-new unit.

Apple launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a shell swap. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, next month's new releases won't update these over-ear headphones, so this week's $120 discount might be the best deal on these premium Apple over-ear headphones for some time.

Previously, only one promotion had a lower price than this — this summer's Prime Day, when they were sold for $30 less than today — though stock was very limited and unstable during the four-day promotion.

Amazon selling this 512GB iPad mini at new pricing $450 off (Renewed Premium)

Although iPad Air deals are starting to appear a bit this week, iPad discounts have generally been weak or nonexistent recently. That said, we found Amazon selling the 512GB iPad mini in top-tier Renewed Premium condition at $450 off the new price.

Amazon is currently selling the 512GB iPad mini A17 — the latest model — for $449 with free shipping.

This Apple iPad, originally priced at $899, can now be purchased directly from Amazon at $450 off.

It's worth noting that even before any price increases, we've never seen this model drop below $679 on Amazon in new condition.

Just a reminder, Amazon Renewed Premium units differ from regular Renewed products, and even 'excellent' condition refurbished units — their shipping standards are as follows:

  • Screen: No scratches, if applicable.
  • Body: No visible cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, etc.) when viewed from 12 inches away.
  • Battery: If included, battery capacity exceeds 90% of original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original accessories and packaging provided.
  • Warranty: Renewed Premium products come with a 365-day return period.

Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models discounted by $220 today (matching Prime Day deals)

While Apple's official certified refurbished store is my first choice for iPhone deals, Apple hasn't listed the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like we'll have to wait until after next month's 18 series launch. Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed products are now back to Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off new unit pricing.

Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed units have always been the best option for unlocked iPhone 17 Pro purchases. Besides saving hundreds of dollars, you also get a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty and 'over 90% of original battery life' — Amazon's non-'Premium' Renewed and refurbished products only come with a 90-day warranty and don't have as good battery life.

Now the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are once again available at up to $220 off — the 512GB version is actually $20 cheaper than previously mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (original new price $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can get an iPhone 16 with a one-year Apple warranty starting from $699, while the 1TB 16 Pro Max is $1,269 — $330 cheaper than the corresponding 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than 17 series)
